records.purpose: Restore this live owner's first prior values; release only successfully verified leases, no-op OK if none.
records.buffer_contract:
`sco_result (*restore_all)(sco_plugin* self);`
Restore this live owner's first prior values; release only successfully verified leases, no-op OK if none.
records.ownership: Per-name exclusive live-owner lease; first prior bool retained before mutation; copied scalar inputs; no allocation transfer.
records.thread_affinity: Game thread only; WRONG_THREAD elsewhere; recursive calls refused.
records.callback_context: Host-only verified offline engine callbacks; no plugin callbacks.
records.reentrancy: FAILED; cleanup during active adapter call retains lease and requires restart.
records.results: BAD_ARG unknown or released handle; UNAVAILABLE stopped/session-ended/terminal/fault admission; FAILED recursive call. Restore bypasses feature capability loss; engine failure or readback mismatch latches restart-required and retains unrestored leases.
records.absent_capability: Table absent: query_service NOT_FOUND; operation unavailable: UNAVAILABLE. Explicit restore may ignore feature capability loss for cleanup.
records.cleanup: Explicit owner restore, ordinary release via existing spawn dispatcher, game.exit and stop restore first priors; failed restoration retains outstanding leases/context, no retry or replacement until process restart. Loader-retained provider faults skip owner hooks; host session/stop cleanup is independent.
limitations: Production engine lookup/get/set signatures/types and native fault boundary unverified; capability OFF.
Portable dispatcher stand-in; Windows spawn dispatcher, SEH, MSVC and gameplay not verified.
No arbitrary console, bridge values or persistent config changes.
